about_the_game:
The content added to CUSTOM ORDER MAID 3D2 It's a Night Magic + GP02 by the Tsundere -Prideful and Competitive- DLC can be accessed in the following way:

1. Become even more intimate with your maid with the marriage system!

After fulfilling the requirements such as likability at the "Cathedral" facility, you will be able to proceed from the "lover" relationship to "bride" with your maid.

2. Private Maid Mode

See one of your favorite maids in a variety of everyday scenes and enjoy the conversations and life around the Empire Club!

3. Empire Life Mode

Adds new events to Empire Life Mode.

Please be advised that this DLC may contain BDSM or BDSM-adjacent content.

-CAUTION-

If you're playing COM3D2 It's a Night Magic without the R-18 patch, you will need update ver. 1.26 to play the "Tsundere ~Prideful and Competitive~" DLC.

Otherwise, Tsundere WILL NOT show up in COM3D2 It's a Night Magic.

Please visit our website and install the update manually.

-Install Instructions-

1. Download update from our website

(It may take awhile to download)

2. Extract the zip folder, and double click the "update.exe" file.
